rollback: Revert the commit; head_expected and heads_observed return to 0027_embedding_cache and the advisory reappears.
security_impact: None. The change updates a recorded expectation inside the reviewed-baseline migrations block of a governance manifest; no application code, schema, or policy changed, and no permission or exposure widened.
